entries.title: The Night We Met
entries.text:
Write your first memory here.

This can be as long as you want — the page scrolls automatically. Use \n\n for paragraph breaks.

entries.title: Another Memory
entries.text: Your second memory goes here. You can have up to 57 entries — just copy this block and add a comma between each one.

entries.title: One More
entries.text: And another one. The date field is optional — leave it out and it simply won't appear.
